name: Assemblée Populaire Nationale
notes: Lower house of the Algerian Parliament (9th legislature elected 12 June 2021; final results proclaimed by the Constitutional Council on 23 June 2021).

name: Conseil de la Nation
notes: Upper house of the Algerian Parliament: 116 members chosen by local and wilaya councillors (two per wilaya) and 58 appointed by the President (the presidential third). Counts by affiliation are from the Conseil de la Nation's own current-members list filtered by party, read on 2026-11-11: the 116 elected members are all listed (FLN 41, RND 25, Front El Moustakbal 15, Indépendants 15, El Bina 7, MSP 4, FFS 4, TAJ 2, Voix du Peuple 2, El Fadjr El Djadid 1), but only 36 presidential-third members were listed, after the third's term ended (the Council honoured the outgoing members and installed a new group chair on 8 July 2026), so 22 of the 58 appointed seats are shown as vacant until the list is completed.

name: Gouvernement de la République Algérienne Démocratique et Populaire
notes: National executive of Algeria (Presidency of the Republic, Prime Minister's Office, and Ministry of Finance).
